purpose: Teach: 勤勉/トラベル/平易/気概/描ける/むい/夏目/偶像

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、勤勉に毎日勉強してたな
lines.en: Riku, you seriously studied hard every single day back then, huh.
lines.style: Teasing Kansai jab softened by real approval; quick pace, smirk audible on the tag.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、トラベル雑誌読んで家族旅行決めたな、桜
lines.en: And you picked your whole family trip out of a travel magazine, right, Sakura.
lines.style: Low deflecting comeback; casual mumble lifting slightly with genuine curiosity on the trip.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、「先生の説明が平易で良い」って言ってたな
lines.en: Riku, you're the one who said the teacher's explanations are nice and plain, weren't you.
lines.style: Mock-serious quoting voice, exaggerating his earnestness; snapping back to breezy on the tag.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、部活で気概を見せてたな、桜
lines.en: Well, you showed some real fighting spirit at club, Sakura.
lines.style: Offhand delivery hiding a real compliment; slight drop in volume, eyes-elsewhere energy.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、漫画が上手に描けるって自慢してたな
lines.en: Riku, you were bragging that you can draw manga really well, weren't you.
lines.style: Needling grin through the whole line; drawn-out stress on the bragging, daring him to deny it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、家庭科でリンゴをむいて練習したろ、桜
lines.en: You practiced peeling apples in home ec, didn't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Quick counterpunch, faster now; a half-laugh riding under the home-ec memory.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、国語で夏目漱石の坊っちゃん読んだろ
lines.en: Riku, you read Soseki's Botchan for Japanese class, right?
lines.style: Curious and less armored; genuine interest slipping through, the title delivered with a small lift.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、「アイドルは偶像じゃなくて生身の人」って言ってたな、桜
lines.en: And you're the one who said idols aren't icons — they're real, living people, Sakura.
lines.style: Quieter, almost respectful quoting her; the coolness cracks, ending on a sincere fall.
